review_description: Deciding to install a solar system took a lot off research (of which Solar Quotes was one source), but it was worthwhile.While we didn't go with one of the three companies recommended by Solar Quotes, it was valuable information and set us on the appropriate path for our installation.Viewing the app to see how much we are consuming and producing each day certainly brings the matter into sharp focus.Haven't had a bill as yet but expect much lower invoice.

Bought the solar system from this supplier as they appeared to be a local provider with an outlet set up in the town. Once the solar boom finished they left town and when I needed a warranty follow up for a faulty inverter it took over 8 weeks to get a replacement inverter under warranty and there appeared to be no urgency to assist at all. After the new inverter was installed I did not receive any follow up or paperwork instructions for the new inverter. I complained in writing about this poor delivery and there was no care factor from this business. Now another problem has occurred with a Low Riso reading and after phoning for assistance I was told it would take over two weeks to service a known problem. Will not recommend Horan and Bird for any sort of solar product.
